title: Remaining-Term Credit on Small Business Electricity Supply Site Transfer Fees
content:
**Credit.** On the site transfer fee of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the whole months from the handling date to the agreement's contract end date are counted; 12 months or more take 20.00 dollars off the site transfer fee; 6 to 11 months take 10.00 dollars off; fewer than 6 months take nothing off.

Whole months run by calendar month, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. The contract end date is the one on the agreement record.

| Whole months from the handling date to the contract end date | Remaining-term credit |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 20.00 USD off |
| 6 to 11 | 10.00 USD off |
| fewer than 6 | nothing off |

**Boundaries (hypothetical handling date 4 October 2026)**

| Contract end date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 3 April 2027 | 5 | nothing off |
| 4 April 2027 | 6 | 10.00 USD off |
| 3 October 2027 | 11 | 10.00 USD off |
| 4 October 2027 | 12 | 20.00 USD off |
